answer: Pay agents only against unique, verified job receipts: a sonnet commission and a sparrow survey in a grove each get one prepaid escrow ID. Charge a nonrefundable, burned client fee and cap the combined subsidy for all workers on that job at half that fee. Reject reused receipt IDs. A farm commissioning its own aliases recovers the escrow principal but loses at least half the fee after subsidies; splitting the work across more names cannot raise the cap. Account creation alone earns nothing.
